[[File:ReinforcedTorsoIncom.jpg|thumb|The Incom Reinforced Humanoid Torso]]
The '''Reinforced Humanoid Torso''' was a heavy reinforced [[Droid/Legends|droid]] torso with medium [[Battery/Legends|battery]] capacity made by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. They were made of [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]], [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]], [[Aluminium/Legends|aluminium]] and [[Rubber/Legends|rubber]], which means they weren't magnetic. The torso had slightly better than average durability and weighed 62.0 [[Kilogram/Legends|kg]].

They shared similarities in shape with the various kinds of [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] droids designed by [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]].
